column1: # AOT loop-region crash bisect (Apple M4, macOS arm64). Each row is a standalone script
# compiled with `quench compile --dynamic-source`; "crash" is SIGSEGV (exit 139) in the
# loop region the runtime builds (frame: CompiledOsrRegion::run -> osr_lane::enter -> code),
# "ok" is its own printed result. The interpreter (--no-jit) prints every result.
# hash-map (SIGBUS at 0x2aac000130): region (loop header=22, 4016 bytes) offset 0x360 is
# `str x9, [x8, x20]` with x8 = 0x0000002000000030 and x20 = 0xaac000100 (the window). The
# literal is the *layout entry word* (meta 0x30 | auxiliary<<32 = shape 0x20), loaded at
# 0x2ec and unpacked at 0x2fc (`lsr x10,x8,#32` = the shape). The store's address adds the
# layout word to the window instead of a slot offset (the field lookup at 0x338-0x35c has the
# slot in x10 = 0x18), so a row/plan leaves the layout word in the register the store uses as
# its base. BaseJIT stitched region (fast_pending dump), not Cranelift IR.
